Name: Anime Seasonal Outfits
Author: fifadog
Description:
Submod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Ohodavi's Anime portrait mod[/url] style

All villager have a new portrait for their seasonal, festival and beach outfits

[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size]
[/b]- Will work with every mod that are compatible with Seasonal outfits slightly cuter aesthetic
- For SVE, please install SVE optional file to make Marlon, Morris and Gunther's portraits work properly.
[size=4]
[/size][size=4]Update
[/size][b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url][b] [/b]just update to version 6.0, which change a mod structure and make old version of this mod incompatible (event outfits will not work)
I already make a new version which should work with version 6.0
[b]
If you are using Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic version[u] 6.0 and above[/u], please use the [u]main version[/u] of this mod
[/b][b]     
If you are using Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic version [u]5.0.2 and below[/u], please use the [u]optional versio[/u]n of this mod

[/b]If you already have old version installed and not plan to update Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic to version 6.0, you can continue using the old mod. (or in stall an optional file if you want a new outfit update for Gus and Emily)


[b][size=3]Installation[/size][/b]
- Install  [Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic] and all it's required mod
- Download and unzip this mod 
- Copy "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters" folder
- Paste "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters" folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
- You will be asked to replace some files, select replaced everything, and you're done
[size=3]
[b]For SVE[/b][/size]
- Only have Olivia, Sophia, Camilla portrait
- Install  [Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE], [Stardew Valley Expanded] and all it's required mod
- Install Main "Anime seasonal portrait" mod 
- Download Anime SVE optional file and copy "[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE" folder
- Paste the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
- Select replaced everything, and you're done
